info.title: Dramaturge - Command-Line Tool
info.description: The dramaturge command-line tool: installs, lists, and removes the browsers and drivers that Dramaturge.Browsers caches, records browser actions as C#, and drives browser sessions for coding agents, from the shell or as an MCP server.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Installs, lists, and removes the browsers and drivers that Dramaturge.Browsers caches, records browser actions as C#, runs browser sessions that commands drive, and serves those commands to MCP hosts.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: browsers
commands.description: Install, list, and remove the browsers and drivers that Dramaturge.Browsers caches.

options.name: --path
options.description: The cache directory. Defaults to DRAMATURGE_BROWSERS_PATH, or the per-user cache directory.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Download browsers and drivers into the cache.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show the version and URL each target resolves to, and whether it is cached, without downloading. [default: False]

arguments.name: TARGETS
arguments.description: The browsers and drivers to install, as name[@channel|@milestone|@version], such as chrome@beta, chromedriver@131, or firefox@134.0. Names: chrome, chrome-headless-shell, firefox, chromedriver, geckodriver, msedgedriver.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the browsers and drivers in the cache.

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Remove browsers and drivers from the cache.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be removed, without removing it. [default: False]

arguments.name: TARGETS
arguments.description: The installations to remove, as name[@channel|@milestone|@version], such as chrome@canary or chromedriver@131.

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Remove every browser and driver from the cache.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be removed, without removing it. [default: False]

commands.name: codegen
commands.description: Record the actions you take in a browser as C#, until you close the browser or press Ctrl+C.

options.name: --target
options.description: The kind of file to write. [default: Program]

options.name: --browser
options.description: The browser to record in. [default: Chrome]

options.name: --channel
options.description: The browser's release channel, as browsers install names it: stable (the default), beta, dev, and canary for Chrome and Edge, or nightly and esr for Firefox.

options.name: --test-id-attribute
options.description: The attribute test IDs are read from. Defaults to data-testid.

options.name: --output
options.description: A file to keep the whole code in as it is recorded.

options.name: --mask-passwords
options.description: Write values typed into, or expected of, password fields as a read of the DRAMATURGE_PASSWORD environment variable. [default: False]

options.name: --path
options.description: The cache directory. Defaults to DRAMATURGE_BROWSERS_PATH, or the per-user cache directory.

commands.name: session
commands.description: Start, list, and stop browser sessions that commands drive.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start a browser session that later commands drive, and that stops with session stop, when its browser closes, or when it is idle.

options.name: --session
options.description: The session's name. [default: default]

options.name: --browser
options.description: The browser to drive. [default: Chrome]

options.name: --channel
options.description: The browser's release channel, as browsers install names it: stable (the default), beta, dev, and canary for Chrome and Edge, or nightly and esr for Firefox.

options.name: --headed
options.description: Show the browser's window. By default the browser has none. [default: False]

options.name: --user-data-dir
options.description: A profile directory for the browser to keep. By default it gets a temporary one.

options.name: --idle-timeout
options.description: The minutes the session waits for a command before it stops. [default: 30]

options.name: --mask-passwords
options.description: Write values typed into, or expected of, password fields in the session's code as a read of the DRAMATURGE_PASSWORD environment variable. [default: False]

options.name: --allow-origin
options.description: An origin, such as https://example.com, the session's pages may navigate to; give it once for each. By default every origin is allowed.

options.name: --allow-file-urls
options.description: Let the session open file: URLs. [default: False]

options.name: --dialogs
options.description: How the browser answers the dialogs pages open, such as confirm: dismiss (the default) or accept. [default: dismiss]

options.name: --allow-upload-from
options.description: A directory files may be uploaded from, with those below it, besides the one the session is started in; give it once for each.

options.name: --downloads
options.description: A directory to save downloads in. By default the session refuses them.

options.name: --path
options.description: The cache directory. Defaults to DRAMATURGE_BROWSERS_PATH, or the per-user cache directory.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the result, or the error, as one line of JSON. [default: False]
